tagline: Innovative Industrial Properties, Inc. is a real estate investment trust (REIT) focused on the acquisition, ownership and management of specialized industrial and commercial properties leased to regulated cannabis operators in the United States.
hero_kpi_rationale: The KPI "Investissements cumulatifs" is the Hero because it reflects the scale of the company's specialized real estate portfolio and its long-term growth strategy in the regulated cannabis facilities sector.

kpis.name: Investissements cumulatifs dans les propriétés
kpis.explanation: Total cumulative amount invested in the property portfolio
kpis.description: The company has cumulatively invested $2.5 billion in its property portfolio (acquisition price and funding of improvements, excluding transaction costs) as of December 31, 2025
kpis.signal: Mature and growing real estate portfolio

kpis.name: Nombre de propriétés en portefeuille
kpis.explanation: Total number of properties held by the company
kpis.description: The company holds 111 properties as of December 31, 2025, with 109 operational properties leased at 96.7%, and a weighted average remaining lease term of 12.8 years

kpis.name: Superficie locative totale
kpis.explanation: Total rentable square footage of the properties held
kpis.description: The company has 8.9 million rentable square feet (including 303,000 square feet under development/redevelopment) across 19 states as of December 31, 2025
kpis.signal: Significant and strategically positioned real estate asset

kpis.name: Investissements cumulatifs dans les propriétés
kpis.explanation: Total cumulative amount invested in the property portfolio
kpis.description: The company has cumulatively invested $2.5 billion in its property portfolio as of December 31, 2025, with a portfolio of 111 properties across 19 states
kpis.signal: Real estate growth strategy confirmed by substantial investments

risks.title: Competition and illicit market pressure
risks.score_rationale: The company faces increased competition from other real estate investors and the illicit cannabis industry, which may reduce opportunities to acquire and operate properties on favorable terms.

risks.title: Regulation and regulatory uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: Cannabis regulations vary by state. The continued federal illegality of cannabis limits access to traditional financing for tenants, and regulatory changes could affect property operations and value. Several states have increased taxation and regulatory requirements.

risks.title: Tenant credit risk and capital availability
risks.score_rationale: Capital availability for cannabis operators remains highly constrained. Operators face high interest rates, market volatility, and refinancing difficulties. Significant debt maturities and limited refinancing options increase financial pressure on tenants and default risk.

risks.title: Pricing dynamics and margin compression
risks.score_rationale: States have experienced sustained declines in unit prices for regulated cannabis products, compressing operator margins. These pricing pressures, combined with high state taxation and illicit market competition, have affected operator profitability in certain markets.

risks.title: Macroeconomic pressures and inflation
risks.score_rationale: Inflation, changes in trade policy, and supply chain disruptions have increased operating and capital costs for cannabis operators and for the company's property development. These pressures may affect tenant capital spending plans and operating margins.

risks.title: Tenant default risk and property re-leasing
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to tenant defaults due to the difficult financial situation of certain operators. unfavorable cannabis markets have already led to tenant defaults and reduced ability of the company to re-lease properties at current rates.

risks.title: Liquidity risk and restructuring
risks.score_rationale: Limited capital availability for cannabis operators, combined with significant debt maturities, may force certain tenants to undergo balance sheet restructurings, asset sales, or operational reductions, affecting lease agreements.

ai_positioning.summary: The company has no clear positioning or significant initiatives related to artificial intelligence mentioned in its 2025 10-K
